title: Encore of Episode 15: Loss and Renewal

sentences.en: This is Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 这里是《隐藏的大脑》节目。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantam.
sentences.zh: 我是尚卡尔·韦丹塔姆。

sentences.en: The turn of the year is a time when we set the old aside and welcome the new into our lives.
sentences.zh: 辞旧迎新之际，我们总会放下过去，迎接生活中的新篇章。

sentences.en: And so today, we bring you a tale of loss and renewal from December 2015.
sentences.zh: 因此，今天我们为您带来一个关于失去与重生的故事，它发生在2015年12月。

sentences.en: It appeals to me for two reasons.
sentences.zh: 这个故事吸引我有两个原因。

sentences.en: The first is, it's a universal story.
sentences.zh: 首先，这是一个普世的故事。

sentences.en: I was really devastated to lose something that I was completely in love with and so passionate about
sentences.zh: 我当时真的深受打击，因为我失去了一样我深爱且充满热情的事物，

sentences.en: and that had really constituted such a large part of my life and my identity.
sentences.zh: 它曾是我生活和身份认同中非常重要的一部分。

sentences.en: You know, I was first and foremost a violiniSt.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我首先是一名小提琴家。

sentences.en: The second reason is that this is also about social science research and its applications in the real world.
sentences.zh: 第二个原因是，这个故事也涉及社会科学研究及其在现实世界中的应用。

sentences.en: What we found was a 9% increase in college enrollment rates as a result of eight text messages.
sentences.zh: 我们发现，仅仅八条短信，就让大学入学率提高了9%。

sentences.en: I mean, that is really profound.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这真的很深刻。

sentences.en: Eight text messages is what I send my best friend on any given day.
sentences.zh: 八条短信，那是我平时随手发给我最好的朋友的数量。

sentences.en: This is Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 这里是《隐藏的大脑》节目。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantam.
sentences.zh: 我是尚卡尔·韦丹塔姆。

sentences.en: Today, we're telling you a story that begins in the attic of a home in Connecticut and ends at the White House.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们要讲述一个故事，它始于康涅狄格州一户人家的阁楼，终于白宫。

sentences.en: And on our theme of loss and reinvention, we'll bring you a poem I came across from Elizabeth Bishop,
sentences.zh: 围绕着“失去与重塑”这个主题，我们将为您带来一首我偶然发现的伊丽莎白·毕肖普的诗，

sentences.en: read by musician Amy Mann.
sentences.zh: 由音乐家艾米·曼朗读。

sentences.en: Then practice losing farther, losing faster.
sentences.zh: 练习去失去，去失去得更远，失去得更快。

sentences.en: Places and names and where it was you meant to travel.
sentences.zh: 那些地方、名字，以及你本打算前往的旅程。

sentences.en: None of these will bring disaster.
sentences.zh: 这一切都不会带来灾难。

sentences.en: My grandmother was an Indian classical violiniSt.
sentences.zh: 我的祖母是一位印度古典小提琴家。

sentences.en: And so my mom had her old violin in our attic for many years.
sentences.zh: 所以多年来，我妈妈一直把她那把旧小提琴放在我们的阁楼里。

sentences.en: This is Maya Shankar.
sentences.zh: 这是玛雅·尚卡尔。

sentences.en: No relation.
sentences.zh: 没有亲戚关系。

sentences.en: Each of my three older siblings had rejected the violin, saying that it wasn't cool enough.
sentences.zh: 我的三个哥哥姐姐都拒绝了这把小提琴，说它不够酷。

sentences.en: And my mom finally gave me the instrument.
sentences.zh: 最后，妈妈把这件乐器给了我。

sentences.en: And I was immediately taken kind of by the tactile sensation of the instrument.
sentences.zh: 我立刻就被这件乐器的触感所吸引。

sentences.en: I mean, the wood and the bow.
sentences.zh: 我是说，那木头和琴弓的质感。

sentences.en: I just loved the feeling of playing the violin.
sentences.zh: 我就是喜欢拉小提琴的感觉。

sentences.en: Even as a child, Maya immediately loved everything about the violin.
sentences.zh: 即使在孩提时代，玛雅也立刻爱上了小提琴的一切。

sentences.en: The way it looked, the way it felt, the way it sounded.
sentences.zh: 它的外观、它的触感、它的声音。

sentences.en: Maya's mother didn't know much about Western classical music, but she signed up her daughter for lessons using the Suzuki method.
sentences.zh: 玛雅的母亲对西方古典音乐了解不多，但她还是用铃木教学法为女儿报了名。

sentences.en: The focus was on playing by ear and making beautiful sound.
sentences.zh: 重点在于通过听觉演奏并发出美妙的声音。

sentences.en: Maya practiced constantly.
sentences.zh: 玛雅不停地练习。

sentences.en: I had a special schedule at school to lump all my classes together so that I'd come a little bit early and get a little bit more practice in.
sentences.zh: 我在学校有一个特殊的课程表，把所有课都排在一起，这样我就能早点放学，多练一会儿琴。

sentences.en: And especially with all the traveling, most days were devoted exclusively to music.
sentences.zh: 尤其是考虑到所有的奔波，大多数日子我几乎全心投入在音乐上。

sentences.en: She got good.
sentences.zh: 她变得很出色。

sentences.en: Very good.
sentences.zh: 非常出色。

sentences.en: Now the part of her musical education that was missing was the formal part.
sentences.zh: 现在，她音乐教育中缺失的部分是正规训练。

sentences.en: She didn't know how to read music very well, but she had a fine ear and she had ambition.
sentences.zh: 她不太会看乐谱，但她有极好的乐感和雄心壮志。

sentences.en: In the pursuit to find a teacher who would take her to the next level, Maya's mother did something quite daring.
sentences.zh: 为了寻找能带她更上一层楼的老师，玛雅的母亲做了一件相当大胆的事。

sentences.en: Yeah, so my mom, she was really a go-getter when it came to my violin life because, like I said,
sentences.zh: 是的，我妈妈在我的小提琴生涯上真的是个行动派，因为就像我说的，

sentences.en: she didn't really have a lot of experience or exposure to the music community and kind of had to innovate in order to find opportunities.
sentences.zh: 她对音乐圈并没有太多经验或接触，为了寻找机会，她不得不另辟蹊径。

sentences.en: They were in New York one day, close to the Juilliard School, one of the world's most famous and exclusive music institutions,
sentences.zh: 有一天，她们在纽约，离世界最著名、最顶尖的音乐学府之一——茱莉亚学院很近，

sentences.en: when her mother came up with an idea.
sentences.zh: 这时她母亲想到了一个主意。

sentences.en: She said,
sentences.zh: 她说：

sentences.en: Why don't we just go to Juilliard?
sentences.zh: 我们为什么不直接去茱莉亚学院呢？

sentences.en: I mean, why not, right?
sentences.zh: 我是说，为什么不呢，对吧？

sentences.en: What can we lose?
sentences.zh: 我们有什么可失去的？

sentences.en: Just walk in the door?
sentences.zh: 直接走进去？

sentences.en: We just walked in.
sentences.zh: 我们就这样走进了大门。

sentences.en: So we walked into the building and just by happenstance, we happened to run into a student in the elevator
sentences.zh: 我们走进大楼，碰巧在电梯里遇到了一个学生，

sentences.en: who studied with a music teacher.
sentences.zh: 他正跟着一位老师学琴。

sentences.en: And my mom talked to that family in the elevator and said,
sentences.zh: 我妈妈在电梯里和那家人交谈，说：

sentences.en: Would you mind if we just had about five or ten minutes at the end of your lesson where Maya could play for your teacher?
sentences.zh: 你们介意在课后留出五到十分钟，让玛雅为你们的老师演奏一下吗？

sentences.en: And they were really gracious and they said,
sentences.zh: 他们非常慷慨，说：

sentences.en: Sure, no problem.
sentences.zh: 当然，没问题。

sentences.en: Of course, you know what happened next.
sentences.zh: 当然，你知道接下来发生了什么。

sentences.en: Maya played for the other student's music teacher,
sentences.zh: 玛雅为那位学生的老师演奏了，

sentences.en: wowed the teacher, and got accepted into a summer program.
sentences.zh: 让老师惊叹不已，并被录取参加了一个暑期项目。

sentences.en: Soon she was taking classes at Juilliard.
sentences.zh: 很快，她就开始在茱莉亚学院上课了。

sentences.en: She was playing with other talented musicians.
sentences.zh: 她开始和其他天才音乐家一起演奏。

sentences.en: She was even being featured on NPR.
sentences.zh: 她甚至还登上了美国国家公共电台（NPR）。

sentences.en: Ah, joining us now is the Juilliard Pre-College Violin Quartet.
sentences.zh: 啊，现在加入我们的是茱莉亚预科小提琴四重奏组。

sentences.en: They are 17-year-old Emily Gendron from Glastonbury, Connecticut,
sentences.zh: 她们是来自康涅狄格州格拉斯顿伯里的17岁女孩艾米丽·根德隆，

sentences.en: 15-year-old Maya Shankar from Cheshire, Connecticut.
sentences.zh: 以及来自康涅狄格州柴郡的15岁女孩玛雅·尚卡尔。

sentences.en: Maya, by the way, is a From the Top veteran.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一下，玛雅是《From the Top》节目的老朋友了。

sentences.en: She's been with us since the early 50s.
sentences.zh: 她从50年代初就一直和我们在一起。

sentences.en: That was Maya on NPR's From the Top.
sentences.zh: 刚才那是玛雅在NPR《From the Top》节目中的表现。

sentences.en: She had found her classical music home.
sentences.zh: 她找到了属于她的古典音乐之家。

sentences.en: She was talented, hardworking, and the path before her seemed clear.
sentences.zh: 她有天赋、勤奋，前方的道路似乎一片光明。

sentences.en: I really wanted to be a violiniSt.
sentences.zh: 我真的想成为一名小提琴家。

sentences.en: I was so passionate about it.
sentences.zh: 我对此充满热情。

sentences.en: I never felt more comfortable than when I was performing.
sentences.zh: 我从未感到比在舞台上表演时更自在。

sentences.en: For some reason, that's where I experienced flow.
sentences.zh: 出于某种原因，那是让我体验到“心流”的地方。

sentences.en: And, you know, the ability to spend a lot of time, you know, practicing and trying to perfect the art,
sentences.zh: 你知道，能够花大量时间练习并试图完善这门艺术，

sentences.en: and then you go on stage and you kind of just surrender, and, you know, you play to the best of your abilities.
sentences.zh: 然后你走上舞台，全身心投入，发挥出你最好的水平。

sentences.en: There was just something beautiful and elegant about that process, and I just really, really loved it.
sentences.zh: 那个过程有一种美丽而优雅的东西，我真的非常非常热爱它。

sentences.en: She was so good and so enthusiastic that opportunities kept presenting themselves.
sentences.zh: 她如此优秀且充满热情，机会不断向她招手。

sentences.en: One day, her teacher at Juilliard arranged for her to play for a famous violiniSt.
sentences.zh: 有一天，她在茱莉亚学院的老师安排她为一位著名的小提琴家演奏。

sentences.en: A very famous violiniSt.
sentences.zh: 一位非常著名的小提琴家。

sentences.en: I nearly fell over in my seat because no reasonable musician thinks they're going to get the opportunity to meet Itzhak Perlman,
sentences.zh: 我差点从座位上跌下来，因为没有理智的音乐家会认为自己有机会见到伊扎克·帕尔曼，

sentences.en: let alone play for Itzhak Perlman.
sentences.zh: 更不用说为伊扎克·帕尔曼演奏了。

sentences.en: Do you remember what you played?
sentences.zh: 你还记得你演奏了什么吗？

sentences.en: I played the Barber Violin Concerto.
sentences.zh: 我演奏了巴伯的小提琴协奏曲。

sentences.en: I played the first movement.
sentences.zh: 我演奏了第一乐章。

sentences.en: Perlman decided to take her on as a student.
sentences.zh: 帕尔曼决定收她为徒。

sentences.en: In addition to Saturdays, I was also going to New York multiple times during the week,
sentences.zh: 除了周六，我每周还会多次去纽约，

sentences.en: either for studio classes at his home in Manhattan or for private lessons or chamber music lessons.
sentences.zh: 要么去他曼哈顿的家中参加工作室课程，要么去上私教课或室内乐课。

sentences.en: And at that point, it was very clear to me that I wanted to become a concert violiniSt.
sentences.zh: 在那一刻，我很清楚自己想成为一名音乐会小提琴家。

sentences.en: Well, I remember that she sounded, and that for me was the most important thing.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我记得她的演奏很有感染力，对我来说，这是最重要的。

sentences.en: To concert violinist Itzhak Perlman, it was okay that Maya had learned to play music by ear rather than by reading music.
sentences.zh: 对于音乐会小提琴家伊扎克·帕尔曼来说，玛雅通过听觉而非读谱来学习音乐是可以接受的。

sentences.en: The technical stuff was important, but it could be learned.
sentences.zh: 技巧固然重要，但它是可以习得的。

sentences.en: You know, it's more important somebody, Nick White has, you know, you have to work on the technique,
sentences.zh: 你知道，更重要的是，你必须练习技巧，

sentences.en: but the important thing is the music, a lovely way of phrasing and so on and so forth.
sentences.zh: 但重要的是音乐本身，那种优美的乐句处理等等。

sentences.en: And so we worked on that, but then we also worked on, you know, how do you accomplish technically,
sentences.zh: 所以我们练习了这些，但我们也探讨了如何从技术上实现它，

sentences.en: for example, in the Barber Tricky, so how do you practice?
sentences.zh: 例如，在巴伯协奏曲中，你该如何练习？

sentences.en: But Perlman didn't just teach Maya how to play the violin.
sentences.zh: 但帕尔曼不仅教玛雅如何拉小提琴。

sentences.en: He taught her something much more important, how to teach herself to play the violin.
sentences.zh: 他教了她更重要的东西：如何自学小提琴。

sentences.en: I remember lots of lessons where instead of telling me,
sentences.zh: 我记得很多次课上，他没有直接告诉我：

sentences.en: Maya, okay, clearly you're unsatisfied with that phrase.
sentences.zh: 玛雅，显然你对那个乐句不满意。

sentences.en: Here's what you should do to make it better.
sentences.zh: 你应该这样做来改进它。

sentences.en: He would instead say, Maya, clearly you're unsatisfied with that phrase.
sentences.zh: 他反而会说：玛雅，显然你对那个乐句不满意。

sentences.en: What do you think you should do in order to make that phrase better?
sentences.zh: 你认为你应该怎么做才能让那个乐句更好？

sentences.en: Let's talk about it.
sentences.zh: 我们来讨论一下。

sentences.en: Let me hear what your aspirations are for the arc of this musical phrase.
sentences.zh: 让我听听你对这个乐句走向的构想。

sentences.en: What tools do you have at your disposal, either with your bow arm or your vibrato or your tone,
sentences.zh: 你手头有什么工具，无论是运弓、揉弦还是音色，

sentences.en: in order to make it beautiful?
sentences.zh: 能让它变得更美？

sentences.en: And it's really frustrating.
sentences.zh: 这真的很让人沮丧。

sentences.en: I mean, in the moment you're thinking, okay, man, like you're the expert here, you know.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，当时你心里想的是，天哪，你是专家啊，

sentences.en: Just tell me what to do.
sentences.zh: 直接告诉我该怎么做就行了。

sentences.en: When Maya was 15, she was practicing at a program run by Itzhak Perlman.
sentences.zh: 玛雅15岁时，正在参加一个由伊扎克·帕尔曼举办的项目。

sentences.en: And I was playing a passage from a very challenging Paganini caprice.
sentences.zh: 当时我正在演奏一段非常有挑战性的帕格尼尼随想曲。

sentences.en: And I simply overstretched my finger on one note, and I felt a kind of a popping.
sentences.zh: 我用力过度拉伤了手指，感觉到“啪”的一声。

sentences.en: And so I overstretched the tendon, and it didn't really heal as expected.
sentences.zh: 我拉伤了肌腱，它并没有像预期的那样愈合。

sentences.en: And so how did you spend the next months?
sentences.zh: 那么接下来的几个月你是怎么度过的？

sentences.en: What did you do?
sentences.zh: 你做了什么？

sentences.en: Well, Mr. Perlman was such a gem.
sentences.zh: 嗯，帕尔曼先生真是个好人。

sentences.en: Because I had injured my left hand, he continued to teach me violin just with my bow arm.
sentences.zh: 因为我的左手受伤了，他继续只教我用运弓的手臂拉琴。

sentences.en: So for over a year, I went to him, and we just worked on perfecting my bow arm.
sentences.zh: 所以有一年多的时间，我去找他，我们只专注于完善我的运弓手臂。

sentences.en: And I would just play open strings in every lesson.
sentences.zh: 每一节课我都在拉空弦。

sentences.en: And he would teach me about how to produce a beautiful sound.
sentences.zh: 他教我如何发出美妙的声音。

sentences.en: It will resolve itself.
sentences.zh: 它会自行解决的。

sentences.en: So usually what happens if one hand doesn't particularly, you know, respond or anything like this,
sentences.zh: 通常如果一只手不太听使唤，或者类似的情况，

sentences.en: you work on the other hand just, you know, not to waste time.
sentences.zh: 你就练习另一只手，以免浪费时间。

sentences.en: Just to do so.
sentences.zh: 只是为了这样做。

sentences.en: If you've got your left hand that has a problem, then you work on the right hand and vice versa.
sentences.zh: 如果你的左手有问题，那就练习右手，反之亦然。

sentences.en: Because, you know, I mean, obviously she wasn't, I mean, I'm sure that she wasn't feeling, what's to use?
sentences.zh: 因为，显然她当时并没有感到……有什么用呢？

sentences.en: Maya's hand didn't heal.
sentences.zh: 玛雅的手没有痊愈。

sentences.en: Doctors finally told her she had to stop playing completely.
sentences.zh: 医生最终告诉她，她必须彻底停止演奏。

sentences.en: I was really devastated to lose something that I was completely in love with
sentences.zh: 我真的深受打击，因为我失去了一样我深爱

sentences.en: and so passionate about, and that had really constituted such a large part of my life and my identity.
sentences.zh: 且充满热情的事物，它曾是我生活和身份认同中非常重要的一部分。

sentences.en: You know, I was first and foremost a violiniSt.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我首先是一名小提琴家。

sentences.en: And so I was anxious because I was worried that I would never find something
sentences.zh: 所以我很焦虑，因为我担心我永远找不到一样

sentences.en: that I felt as passionately about as I did with music.
sentences.zh: 像热爱音乐那样让我充满热情的事物。

sentences.en: Just like that, Maya's dream to become a concert violinist was over.
sentences.zh: 就这样，玛雅成为音乐会小提琴家的梦想破灭了。

sentences.en: Back home for the summer in Connecticut, she started to ask herself how she could pick up the pieces.
sentences.zh: 暑假回到康涅狄格州，她开始问自己该如何重拾破碎的生活。

sentences.en: Would she ever find anything that could make her as happy as the violin?
sentences.zh: 她还能找到什么能像小提琴一样让她快乐吗？

sentences.en: Our next guest appeared as a violinist on a pilot episode when she was just 12 years old.
sentences.zh: 我们的下一位嘉宾在12岁时就曾以小提琴家的身份出现在试播集中。

sentences.en: She's now 23, and during those intervening years, well, brace yourself,
sentences.zh: 她现在23岁了，在这些年里，嗯，做好心理准备，

sentences.en: because what she's accomplished is a little humbling to us mere mortals.
sentences.zh: 因为她所取得的成就让我们这些凡人感到有些自惭形秽。

sentences.en: Please welcome Maya Shankar.
sentences.zh: 请欢迎玛雅·尚卡尔。

sentences.en: To find out what Maya did, stay with us.
sentences.zh: 想知道玛雅做了什么，请继续收听。

sentences.en: This is Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 这里是《隐藏的大脑》节目。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantam.
sentences.zh: 我是尚卡尔·韦丹塔姆。

sentences.en: On our last podcast of the year, we're exploring the idea of closing the book on one chapter of your life
sentences.zh: 在今年的最后一期播客中，我们探讨了合上人生一章，

sentences.en: and opening another.
sentences.zh: 开启新篇章的想法。

sentences.en: We're doing it through the story of Maya Shankar.
sentences.zh: 我们通过玛雅·尚卡尔的故事来讲述这一点。

sentences.en: After learning she could no longer play the violin due to an injury to her left hand,
sentences.zh: 在得知由于左手受伤而无法再拉小提琴后，

sentences.en: Maya retreated to her parents' home in Connecticut.
sentences.zh: 玛雅回到了康涅狄格州父母的家中。

sentences.en: Her life felt in disarray.
sentences.zh: 她感到生活一团糟。

sentences.en: The summer before, doctors basically told me I had to stop playing completely.
sentences.zh: 前一年夏天，医生基本上告诉我，我必须彻底停止演奏。

sentences.en: And just by luck, I was helping my parents clean their basement in Cheshire, Connecticut,
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，当时我正在康涅狄格州柴郡帮父母清理地下室，

sentences.en: and I stumbled upon an old course book of my sister's.
sentences.zh: 无意中发现了我姐姐的一本旧教材。

sentences.en: It was called The Language Instinct by Steven Pinker.
sentences.zh: 书名是史蒂芬·平克的《语言本能》。

sentences.en: Maya started reading, and the more she read, the more excited she became.
sentences.zh: 玛雅开始阅读，读得越多，她就越兴奋。

sentences.en: It was remarkable for me to learn about just how complex our minds were
sentences.zh: 了解到我们的大脑竟然如此复杂，

sentences.en: and just what was required in order for us to have our day-to-day experiences.
sentences.zh: 以及我们进行日常体验所需的条件，这让我感到非常震撼。

sentences.en: And so it really whet my appetite for learning more about the mind
sentences.zh: 这确实激发了我进一步了解大脑的兴趣，

sentences.en: and for exploring in more depth kind of the brilliance of the brain.
sentences.zh: 也让我更深入地探索了大脑的卓越之处。

sentences.en: She started to study cognitive science.
sentences.zh: 她开始学习认知科学。

sentences.en: She went on to get her Ph.D.
sentences.zh: 后来她获得了博士学位，

sentences.en: at Oxford on a Rhodes Scholarship.
sentences.zh: 是在牛津大学通过罗德奖学金完成的。

sentences.en: She got a postdoctoral fellowship.
sentences.zh: 她获得了博士后研究职位。

sentences.en: A promising career in academia lay ahead of her.
sentences.zh: 学术界的前途一片光明。

sentences.en: But here again came another unexpected turn.
sentences.zh: 但意想不到的转折再次出现了。

sentences.en: So over Thanksgiving break of the final year of my postdoc,
sentences.zh: 在我博士后最后一年的感恩节假期期间，

sentences.en: I was at home and I was visiting my undergraduate advisor from college.
sentences.zh: 我回家探望了我在大学时的本科导师。

sentences.en: Her name's Lori Santos.
sentences.zh: 她叫洛里·桑托斯。

sentences.en: And she was telling me about the U.S.
sentences.zh: 她当时正跟我谈论美国

sentences.en: Department of Agriculture's efforts
sentences.zh: 农业部所做的努力，

sentences.en: to get free and reduced-price lunches, school lunches,
sentences.zh: 旨在让更多符合条件的贫困学生

sentences.en: into the hands of more eligible students.
sentences.zh: 享受到免费或减价的学校午餐。

sentences.en: Students were going hungry because the process of getting certified
sentences.zh: 学生们挨饿是因为申请

sentences.en: for the lunch program was cumbersome.
sentences.zh: 午餐项目的认证过程非常繁琐。

sentences.en: The Department of Agriculture came up with a simple idea.
sentences.zh: 农业部想出了一个简单的办法。

sentences.en: Instead of having a multi-step sign-up system,
sentences.zh: 与其使用多步骤的注册系统，

sentences.en: states could use information they already had about poor families
sentences.zh: 各州可以直接利用已有的贫困家庭信息，

sentences.en: to help enroll children in the lunch program.
sentences.zh: 帮助孩子们加入午餐项目。

sentences.en: And it's just a matter of data matching and cross-enrolling these students.
sentences.zh: 这只是一个数据匹配和交叉注册的问题。

sentences.en: But as a result of this common-sense reform,
sentences.zh: 但正是由于这项常识性的改革，

sentences.en: you know, 12.4 million students as of 2015
sentences.zh: 你知道，截至2015年，

sentences.en: were automatically enrolled into the school lunch program
sentences.zh: 有1240万名学生被自动纳入学校午餐项目，

sentences.en: and had access to lunches and were able to thrive at school.
sentences.zh: 获得了午餐保障，并在学校里茁壮成长。

sentences.en: And I remember being so moved by this example.
sentences.zh: 我记得当时被这个例子深深打动了。

sentences.en: To Maya, it was magical.
sentences.zh: 对玛雅来说，这简直太神奇了。

sentences.en: It was just like a light bulb went off in my head.
sentences.zh: 就像我的脑子里突然亮起了一盏灯。

sentences.en: And I thought, OK, this is what I need to be doing with my life.
sentences.zh: 我想，好吧，这就是我余生应该做的事情。

sentences.en: I want to be taking research insights from the behavioral sciences
sentences.zh: 我想将行为科学的研究见解，

sentences.en: and allowing them to find their way into public policy
sentences.zh: 应用到公共政策中，

sentences.en: so that they can be in the service of Americans and people around the world.
sentences.zh: 从而为美国乃至全世界的人民服务。

sentences.en: So how do you break into the world of policy
sentences.zh: 那么，当你只是一个卑微的博士后时，

sentences.en: when you're just a lowly postdoc?
sentences.zh: 该如何进入政策领域呢？

sentences.en: Maya knew nothing of politics.
sentences.zh: 玛雅对政治一窍不通。

sentences.en: She didn't have connections in the world of government.
sentences.zh: 她在政府部门没有任何人脉。

sentences.en: But she did remember a lesson her mother had taught her
sentences.zh: 但她记得母亲多年前在茱莉亚学院外

sentences.en: standing outside the Juilliard school years earlier.
sentences.zh: 教给她的一个经验。

sentences.en: She tracked down an email address for Thomas Kalia,
sentences.zh: 她找到了托马斯·卡利亚的电子邮箱，

sentences.en: who was helping the Obama administration with its science policy.
sentences.zh: 他当时正在协助奥巴马政府制定科学政策。

sentences.en: I sent Tom, again, a cold email.
sentences.zh: 我又给汤姆发了一封冷邮件。

sentences.en: This is the Juilliard method again.
sentences.zh: 这又是茱莉亚方法。

sentences.en: This is my mom's Juilliard.
sentences.zh: 这是我妈妈的茱莉亚方法。

sentences.en: I get to give her full credit for this.
sentences.zh: 我得把全部功劳归给她。

sentences.en: She is totally fearless and kind of inspired this trait.
sentences.zh: 她非常无畏，这种特质启发了我。

sentences.en: And I went over to his home, and he asked me to pitch to him ideas
sentences.zh: 我去了他家，他让我推销一下我的想法，

sentences.en: that I had around interventions where behavioral science could improve
sentences.zh: 关于行为科学如何能改善

sentences.en: public policy outcomes.
sentences.zh: 公共政策成果的干预措施。

sentences.en: What did you tell him?
sentences.zh: 你跟他说了什么？

sentences.en: I talked to him about a number of things,
sentences.zh: 我跟他谈了很多事情，

sentences.en: like the importance of using social norms to motivate behavior.
sentences.zh: 比如利用社会规范来激励行为的重要性。

sentences.en: So we know from research that if you tell people that their neighbors use
sentences.zh: 研究表明，如果你告诉人们他们的邻居比他们

sentences.en: less energy than they do, right, they're more likely to use less energy.
sentences.zh: 消耗的能源更少，他们就更有可能减少能源消耗。

sentences.en: And there's a lot of domains in which just telling people what the data shows
sentences.zh: 在很多领域，仅仅告诉人们数据所显示的

sentences.en: about people's actions and decisions can actually drive actions that are more
sentences.zh: 关于人们行为和决策的结果，实际上就能推动人们采取

sentences.en: in alignment with people's long-term goals or with policy objectives.
sentences.zh: 更符合其长期目标或政策目标的行动。

sentences.en: And something that struck me about that conversation is I had been talking for years
sentences.zh: 那次谈话中有一点让我印象深刻，多年来我一直

sentences.en: with my academic colleagues about the potential applications of using behavioral insights
sentences.zh: 与学术界的同事讨论利用行为洞察力

sentences.en: to improve people's lives.
sentences.zh: 改善人们生活的潜在应用。

sentences.en: And this was the first time that when I told him an idea that I had,
sentences.zh: 而这是第一次，当我告诉他我的想法时，

sentences.en: his response was, oh, we can find a way to do that.
sentences.zh: 他的回应是：哦，我们可以找到办法实现它。

sentences.en: Maya joined the White House.
sentences.zh: 玛雅加入了白宫。

sentences.en: She was asked to put together a team that could marshal ideas from social science research
sentences.zh: 她被要求组建一个团队，整合社会科学研究的理念，

sentences.en: and apply them to public policy challenges.
sentences.zh: 并将其应用于公共政策挑战。

sentences.en: You've had a chance in your current role to actually work on this project
sentences.zh: 在目前的职位上，你有机会参与了这个项目，

sentences.en: that started you on this mission, the school lunch program.
sentences.zh: 也就是让你走上这条使命之路的学校午餐项目。

sentences.en: Can you tell me a little bit about that?
sentences.zh: 能跟我谈谈这个吗？

sentences.en: So we have been working with the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我们一直在与美国

sentences.en: Department of Agriculture and also local school districts
sentences.zh: 农业部以及当地学区合作，

sentences.en: to redesign communications that they're sending to families to help promote the verification process
sentences.zh: 重新设计他们发给家庭的通知，以促进验证过程，

sentences.en: so that their kids can stay on the benefit.
sentences.zh: 确保孩子们能持续获得福利。

sentences.en: So we've done a few things.
sentences.zh: 我们做了一些改进。

sentences.en: So there's a few behavioral insights that we've used.
sentences.zh: 我们运用了一些行为洞察力。

sentences.en: One is we've taken a very long list of, you know, action steps required for verification
sentences.zh: 首先，我们将验证所需的冗长行动步骤清单，

sentences.en: and condense them into three easy-to-understand steps that you can take.
sentences.zh: 精简为三个简单易懂的步骤。

sentences.en: Two, we've worked with school districts to translate the communications into multiple languages
sentences.zh: 其次，我们与学区合作，将通知翻译成多种语言，

sentences.en: in order to support comprehension among the diverse population that this program serves.
sentences.zh: 以帮助该项目服务的多元化群体理解内容。

sentences.en: One issue is that at present, families might only think the way to recertify
sentences.zh: 目前的一个问题是，家庭可能认为重新认证

sentences.en: or to verify their information is to send snail mail back to the school district.
sentences.zh: 或验证信息的唯一方式就是通过邮政信件寄回给学区。

sentences.en: And instead, there's the opportunity for them to take a picture of their information using their mobile phones
sentences.zh: 而实际上，他们完全可以用手机拍下信息，

sentences.en: and actually email it back.
sentences.zh: 直接通过电子邮件发回。

sentences.en: And we simply notified people of the opportunity to go through that process.
sentences.zh: 我们只是通知了人们可以采用这种方式。

sentences.en: And then in other instances, we included prepaid envelopes
sentences.zh: 在其他情况下，我们附上了预付邮资的信封，

sentences.en: to help ease the process of verifying eligibility.
sentences.zh: 以帮助简化验证资格的过程。

sentences.en: So I'm trying to think about why it is we often have trouble sort of thinking about programs like this
sentences.zh: 我一直在思考，为什么我们有时很难想到这类项目，

sentences.en: because as someone who has been interested in human behavior for a while,
sentences.zh: 因为作为一个长期关注人类行为的人，

sentences.en: it seems to me that programs like these really are, you know, no pun intended, a no-brainer,
sentences.zh: 在我看来，这类项目确实是显而易见的，

sentences.en: that this is really something that we should be doing.
sentences.zh: 这确实是我们应该做的事情。

sentences.en: It seems obvious that we should be doing it.
sentences.zh: 我们应该做这件事似乎是显而易见的。

sentences.en: But I think part of the issue is that I think many people might say,
sentences.zh: 但我认为问题的一部分在于，很多人可能会说，

sentences.en: if you want to stay in a program that's giving you benefits
sentences.zh: 如果你想留在提供福利的项目中，

sentences.en: and these are the steps you need to do in order to get the benefits
sentences.zh: 而这些是你获得福利所必须采取的步骤，

sentences.en: and you deserve those benefits, rationally speaking,
sentences.zh: 且你理应获得这些福利，那么从理性角度来说，

sentences.en: you should be willing to do those steps in order to get the benefits.
sentences.zh: 你应该愿意采取这些步骤来获得福利。

sentences.en: And I think it fails to take into account the difference between how human beings
sentences.zh: 我认为这种看法忽略了人类作为理性生物

sentences.en: are supposed to behave as rational creatures and how they actually behave.
sentences.zh: 应该有的行为与实际行为之间的差异。

sentences.en: And I feel like that's the central divide that your work is trying to bridge.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这就是你的工作试图弥合的核心鸿沟。

sentences.en: And I think additionally, you know, the onus is on the government to present information clearly,
sentences.zh: 此外，我认为政府有责任清晰地呈现信息，

sentences.en: to present choices clearly, so that people understand what program exists
sentences.zh: 清晰地呈现选择，让人们了解现有的项目，

sentences.en: and what their options are and can make the best decisions for themselves and their families.
sentences.zh: 明确自己的选择，从而为自己和家人做出最佳决策。

sentences.en: But there's one example that I wanted to point to, which is a phenomenon known as summer melt.
sentences.zh: 但我还想指出一个例子，即所谓的“暑期流失”现象。

sentences.en: This is the phenomenon where talented high school students
sentences.zh: 这是一种现象，即那些在暑假开始时

sentences.en: who are on track to go to college at the start of the summer
sentences.zh: 本已准备好上大学的优秀高中生，

sentences.en: somehow lose their way and don't show up at college in the fall.
sentences.zh: 却在秋季开学时没能去学校报到。

sentences.en: Maya and her team have worked on simple, low-cost interventions
sentences.zh: 玛雅和她的团队致力于研究简单、低成本的干预措施，

sentences.en: that can help these students get to college.
sentences.zh: 帮助这些学生顺利进入大学。

sentences.en: Their idea?
sentences.zh: 他们的办法是什么？

sentences.en: Send the students eight text messages over the summer
sentences.zh: 在暑假期间给学生发送八条短信，

sentences.en: reminding them of impending deadlines.
sentences.zh: 提醒他们即将到来的截止日期。

sentences.en: What we found was a 9% increase in college enrollment rates
sentences.zh: 我们发现，八条短信使大学入学率提高了9%。

sentences.en: as a result of eight text messages.
sentences.zh: 这确实意义深远。

sentences.en: I mean, that is really profound.
sentences.zh: 八条短信是我平时发给我最好的朋友的数量。

sentences.en: Eight text messages is what I send my best friend on any given day.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，你所做的事情和你所经历的，

sentences.en: It seems to me that what you did and what happened to you
sentences.zh: 其实一直在很多人身上发生，

sentences.en: is actually happens to lots of people all the time
sentences.zh: 当一扇门关闭时，他们会觉得无法承受，

sentences.en: where doors close and they feel like it's unbearable that this door has closed
sentences.zh: 因为那是他们以为自己安身立命的地方。

sentences.en: because this is where I thought I lived.
sentences.zh: 然后另一扇门打开了，你意识到其实

sentences.en: And then another door opens and you realize there are actually
sentences.zh: 我们还有很多很多可以居住的房子。

sentences.en: many, many houses in which we can live.
sentences.zh: 我认为你说得完全正确。

sentences.en: I think that's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，拉小提琴的一大益处，

sentences.en: And I think, you know, one thing that violin,
sentences.zh: 就是它让我真正体会到了

sentences.en: one of the great blessings of playing the violin
sentences.zh: 热爱某件事并为之充满激情的感觉。

sentences.en: is that it allowed me to see what it really felt like
sentences.zh: 所以，如果说有什么的话，你会看到

sentences.en: to be in love with something and to be really passionate about something.
sentences.zh: 通过投入那项追求，你身上被挖掘出的特质或品质。

sentences.en: And so, if anything, you see sort of features or traits
sentences.zh: 而你的希望是，在新的探索中，

sentences.en: that are extracted in you from engaging with that pursuit.
sentences.zh: 那些学科或领域也能从你身上挖掘出同样的品质。

sentences.en: And then your hope is that in the new explorations,
sentences.zh: 我想知道，当你思考自己的人生时，

sentences.en: those disciplines or those areas can extract those same qualities from you.
sentences.zh: 你觉得你的职业生涯已经定型了吗？

sentences.en: I'm wondering, as you think about your own life,
sentences.zh: 这就是你将永远居住的房子吗？

sentences.en: do you feel that your career now has been set?
sentences.zh: 还是说，你相信在未来，

sentences.en: This is the house you're going to live in forever?
sentences.zh: 你还会住进许多其他的房子里？

sentences.en: Do you actually believe, on the other hand,
sentences.zh: 嗯，我从未像现在这样快乐，

sentences.en: that there might be many other houses you will one day come to live in?
sentences.zh: 从事公共服务，并利用我的背景

sentences.en: Well, I've certainly never been happier than I am right now
sentences.zh: 来帮助改善人们的生活。

sentences.en: working in public service and using my background
sentences.zh: 所以，我认为这将继续成为

sentences.en: to help improve people's lives.
sentences.zh: 我所做的一切工作的一个共同主题。

sentences.en: So, I think that that will continue to be a common theme
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，我认为这种激情

sentences.en: of whatever it is that I end up doing and working in.
sentences.zh: 可以通过许多方式展现出来，对吧？

sentences.en: That said, I think there are so many ways
sentences.zh: 这就是我所想的。

sentences.en: in which that passion can manifest, right?
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And I think that one thing the past has taught me
sentences.zh: 我认为过去教会我的一件事是

sentences.en: is that the world has endless opportunities
sentences.zh: 世界充满了无限的机遇

sentences.en: to positively impact people's lives.
sentences.zh: 去对人们的生活产生积极的影响。

sentences.en: And along the way, I might explore various different paths
sentences.zh: 在此过程中，我可能会探索各种不同的路径

sentences.en: in order to get there.
sentences.zh: 以达成目标。

sentences.en: But as long as I stick to that core value
sentences.zh: 但只要我坚持那个核心价值观，

sentences.en: of trying to help people and improve people's lives,
sentences.zh: 即努力帮助他人、改善人们的生活，

sentences.en: I think that there are many ways to do that.
sentences.zh: 我认为有很多方法可以做到这一点。

sentences.en: And of course, you have the cold call Juilliard method to aid you.
sentences.zh: 当然，你还有“朱莉亚学院式冷呼叫”法来助你一臂之力。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So, I think that, yeah, again, thanks to my mom,
sentences.zh: 所以，我想，是的，再次感谢我的母亲，

sentences.en: I think that there is always that foolproof method
sentences.zh: 我认为总有那种万无一失的方法，

sentences.en: of the standard cold call.
sentences.zh: 也就是标准的冷呼叫。

sentences.en: That was Maya Shankar.
sentences.zh: 以上是玛雅·尚卡尔。

sentences.en: She served as Senior Advisor for the Social and Behavioral Sciences
sentences.zh: 她曾担任社会与行为科学高级顾问，

sentences.en: at the White House Office of Science and Technology Policy
sentences.zh: 在白宫科技政策办公室任职，

sentences.en: under President Obama.
sentences.zh: 服务于奥巴马总统时期。

sentences.en: Since then, Maya has left the White House
sentences.zh: 此后，玛雅离开了白宫，

sentences.en: and become Google's first head of behavioral insights.
sentences.zh: 成为了谷歌首位行为洞察主管。

sentences.en: I told you at the start of this episode
sentences.zh: 我在本集开头就告诉过你，

sentences.en: that Maya's story is a universal story.
sentences.zh: 玛雅的故事是一个普世的故事。

sentences.en: Now, not all of us are going to be concert violinists
sentences.zh: 当然，我们并非都能成为音乐会小提琴家，

sentences.en: or Rhodes Scholars or presidential advisors,
sentences.zh: 或是罗德学者或总统顾问，

sentences.en: but I don't think any of those things
sentences.zh: 但我认为这些都不是

sentences.en: are the real point of Maya's story.
sentences.zh: 玛雅故事的真正重点。

sentences.en: The reason I wanted to tell you the story
sentences.zh: 我之所以想在新年伊始

sentences.en: at the turn of a new year
sentences.zh: 讲述这个故事，

sentences.en: is because all of us have chapters in our lives that close.
sentences.zh: 是因为我们每个人的生命中都有翻篇的章节。

sentences.en: And when they do,
sentences.zh: 而当它们翻篇时，

sentences.en: especially if it's a chapter we have known and loved
sentences.zh: 尤其是如果那是我们熟悉并热爱了

sentences.en: for a long time,
sentences.zh: 很久的篇章，

sentences.en: it can feel like the whole book is over,
sentences.zh: 可能会让人觉得整本书都结束了，

sentences.en: that there's nothing left to do,
sentences.zh: 觉得再也没有什么可做的了，

sentences.en: maybe even nothing left to live for.
sentences.zh: 甚至觉得没什么值得活下去的了。

sentences.en: But I think each of us has stories in our lives
sentences.zh: 但我认为我们每个人生命中的故事都反映出，

sentences.en: that reflect the fact that the people we are today
sentences.zh: 今天的我们

sentences.en: are not the same people we were a few years ago.
sentences.zh: 与几年前的我们已截然不同。

sentences.en: We often underestimate our capacity to reinvent ourselves.
sentences.zh: 我们常常低估了自己重塑自我的能力。

sentences.en: I was talking some years ago with Rick Potts.
sentences.zh: 几年前我曾与里克·波茨交谈过。

sentences.en: He's a paleoanthropologist
sentences.zh: 他是一位古人类学家，

sentences.en: and the head of the Smithsonian Institution's
sentences.zh: 也是史密森尼学会

sentences.en: Human Origins Program.
sentences.zh: 人类起源项目的负责人。

sentences.en: And something he said stuck in my head.
sentences.zh: 他说的某句话一直萦绕在我的脑海里。

sentences.en: He told me that the thing that distinguished
sentences.zh: 他告诉我，区分

sentences.en: early humans from other species
sentences.zh: 早期人类与其他物种的特质，

sentences.en: was our remarkable capacity
sentences.zh: 在于我们非凡的适应能力，

sentences.en: to adapt to different conditions,
sentences.zh: 去适应不同的环境，

sentences.en: different situations.
sentences.zh: 不同的境遇。

sentences.en: Uniquely, humans live in very cold places
sentences.zh: 人类独特之处在于，我们既能生活在极寒之地，

sentences.en: and very hot places
sentences.zh: 也能生活在极热之地，

sentences.en: at altitude and sea level.
sentences.zh: 无论是在高海拔还是海平面。

sentences.en: Some of us live long periods underwater
sentences.zh: 我们中有些人能在水下长期生活，

sentences.en: or even in outer space.
sentences.zh: 甚至在外太空。

sentences.en: Most of that isn't about our physical abilities.
sentences.zh: 这大部分并非源于我们的身体能力。

sentences.en: It's really about the mind.
sentences.zh: 这实际上关乎思想。

sentences.en: And each year, around this time,
sentences.zh: 每年这个时候，

sentences.en: we need to remind ourselves
sentences.zh: 我们都需要提醒自己，

sentences.en: that as one door closes,
sentences.zh: 当一扇门关闭时，

sentences.en: we have the ability to find other doors to open.
sentences.zh: 我们有能力找到其他开启的门。

sentences.en: I want to leave you with a lovely poem
sentences.zh: 最后我想留给你们一首优美的诗，

sentences.en: by Elizabeth Bishop.
sentences.zh: 作者是伊丽莎白·毕肖普。

sentences.en: Singer Amy Mann happened to be at NPR
sentences.zh: 歌手艾米·曼恰好在NPR，

sentences.en: and we asked her to read the poem for us.
sentences.zh: 我们请她为我们朗读了这首诗。

sentences.en: One Art by Elizabeth Bishop
sentences.zh: 《一种艺术》，作者：伊丽莎白·毕肖普

sentences.en: The art of losing isn't hard to master.
sentences.zh: 失去的艺术并不难掌握。

sentences.en: So many things seem filled with the intent to be lost
sentences.zh: 许多事物似乎注定要被失去，

sentences.en: that their loss is no disaster.
sentences.zh: 所以它们的失去并非灾难。

sentences.en: Lose something every day
sentences.zh: 每天失去一点东西，

sentences.en: except the fluster of lost door keys,
sentences.zh: 除了弄丢门钥匙的慌乱，

sentences.en: the hour badly spent.
sentences.zh: 以及虚度的光阴。

sentences.en: The art of losing isn't hard to master.
sentences.zh: 失去的艺术并不难掌握。

sentences.en: Then practice losing farther, losing faster.
sentences.zh: 然后练习失去得更远，失去得更快。

sentences.en: Places and names and where it was you meant to travel.
sentences.zh: 地点、名字，以及你本打算前往的地方。

sentences.en: None of these will bring disaster.
sentences.zh: 这些都不会带来灾难。

sentences.en: I lost my mother's watch.
sentences.zh: 我弄丢了我母亲的手表。

sentences.en: And look, my last or next to last
sentences.zh: 看，我那三座心爱的房子里，

sentences.en: of three loved houses went.
sentences.zh: 最后或倒数第二座也已失去。

sentences.en: The art of losing isn't hard to master.
sentences.zh: 失去的艺术并不难掌握。

sentences.en: I lost two cities, lovely ones,
sentences.zh: 我失去了两座城市，可爱的城市，

sentences.en: and vaster, some realms I owned,
sentences.zh: 还有更广阔的，我曾拥有的疆域，

sentences.en: two rivers, a continent.
sentences.zh: 两条河流，一片大陆。

sentences.en: I miss them, but it wasn't a disaster.
sentences.zh: 我怀念它们，但这并非灾难。

sentences.en: Even losing you,
sentences.zh: 即使是失去你，

sentences.en: the joking voice, a gesture I love.
sentences.zh: 那戏谑的声音，我钟爱的姿态。

sentences.en: I shan't have lied.
sentences.zh: 我没有撒谎。

sentences.en: It's evident the art of losing's
sentences.zh: 显而易见，失去的艺术

sentences.en: not too hard to master,
sentences.zh: 并不太难掌握，

sentences.en: though it may look like,
sentences.zh: 尽管它看起来，

sentences.en: write it like disaster.
sentences.zh: 写起来就像一场灾难。

sentences.en: That was Amy Mann,
sentences.zh: 刚才那是艾米·曼，

sentences.en: reading One Art by Elizabeth Bishop.
sentences.zh: 朗读伊丽莎白·毕肖普的《一种艺术》。

sentences.en: Amy was at NPR with Ted Leo
sentences.zh: 艾米当时和泰德·里奥在NPR，

sentences.en: to perform for the
sentences.zh: 为《All Songs Considered》

sentences.en: All Songs Considered podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 播客进行表演。

sentences.en: Our unsung hero this week
sentences.zh: 本周我们幕后的英雄

sentences.en: is someone who helped me reinvent
sentences.zh: 是一位帮助我重塑了

sentences.en: my own life.
sentences.zh: 自己生活的人。

sentences.en: Paul Ginsberg is a long-time
sentences.zh: 保罗·金斯伯格是一位长期的

sentences.en: NPR supporter and donor.
sentences.zh: NPR支持者和捐赠者。

sentences.en: In December 2013,
Paul came to me
sentences.zh: 保罗找到我，

sentences.en: and told me I should be doing more
sentences.zh: 告诉我我不应该只做

sentences.en: than just weekly stories for radio.
sentences.zh: 每周的广播故事。

sentences.en: What about a podcast, he asked.
sentences.zh: 他问，为什么不做个播客呢？

sentences.en: Paul did more than just
sentences.zh: 保罗所做的不仅仅是

sentences.en: simply toss out an idea.
sentences.zh: 随口提个建议。

sentences.en: He helped to make it a reality.
sentences.zh: 他帮助将其变成了现实。

sentences.en: He raised funds to launch Hidden Brain,
sentences.zh: 他筹集资金创办了《Hidden Brain》，

sentences.en: and he's been a trusted friend
sentences.zh: 从那时起，他一直是我值得信赖的朋友

sentences.en: and advisor ever since.
sentences.zh: 和顾问。

sentences.en: More than time and money,
sentences.zh: 除了时间和金钱，

sentences.en: Paul gave me
sentences.zh: 保罗给了我

sentences.en: what might be the most valuable gift
sentences.zh: 一个人能给予另一个人

sentences.en: one person can give another.
sentences.zh: 最宝贵的礼物。

sentences.en: He helped me see something in myself
sentences.zh: 他帮我看到了自己身上

sentences.en: that I had not seen on my own.
sentences.zh: 我未曾独自发现的东西。

sentences.en: Thanks, Paul.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，保罗。

sentences.en: From everyone at Hidden Brain,
sentences.zh: 《Hidden Brain》全体成员祝愿大家在

sentences.en: we wish you new paths,
sentences.zh: 新的一年里，

sentences.en: new dreams,
sentences.zh: 拥有新的路径、

sentences.en: and much reinvention
sentences.zh: 新的梦想，

sentences.en: this coming year.
sentences.zh: 以及更多的自我重塑。
